title: Discovery Call
text: In 20 minutes we learn your goals, audience and timeline, and you learn what's possible and what it costs.

title: Custom Proposal
text: We send tiered options after the call, and you pick the scope that fits. Every cost is in the proposal.

title: Production Day
text: We show up prepared and handle the gear, the direction and the logistics. All you need to do is be yourself.

title: Delivery
text: You get the final files by private Frame.io link, at full resolution. They're yours to keep, with no licensing strings attached.
